1.1.0: Bug Fixes: Fixed the Users and Posts dropdown input fields
1.2.0: Added test() (Flow Test Mode) to all triggers: NewPost, NewComment.
1.3.0: Added MakeApiCall component for performing arbitrary authorized API calls to the WordPress API.
1.3.1: Added output schemas with examples to the NewPost trigger.
1.3.2: NewComment: the site and post pickers are now typeahead text fields, so a value can still be entered when the list fails to load; added output schemas with examples.
1.3.3: CreatePost now stops with a clear error when the title or content is missing instead of calling the API; the site and author pickers are typeaheads; added output schemas with examples.
1.3.4: MakeApiCall: Request Headers and Query Parameters set in the Designer are now sent. They were silently dropped: the key-value field stores its rows as a JSON object string, which the component did not parse.
1.3.5: Declared lodash as a direct dependency. It was previously only installed as a transitive dependency. No functional change.
